connectors.name: AnimeUnity
connectors.releaseNotes: 0.1.4: revert the streams graph to the two-step form (embed-url -> vixcloud). The app's part:attr validation rejects underscore attribute names, so the episode page's embed_url attribute is unreadable; the slug-trick graph is dropped. Evidence review: the 0.2.2 reports were Sub requests on (ITA) dub-only titles - honest no-candidate results, so the original graph was likely functional. Test with the correct variant per title.

connectors.name: AnimeWorld
connectors.releaseNotes: Candidato 0.1.0: discovery (newest + updated), search, details, episodes e streams in un solo passo dichiarativo - la pagina player di AnimeWorld (/api/episode/serverPlayerAnimeWorld?id={episodeID}) è HTML server-rendered con <source src> = MP4 diretto su *.sweetpixel.org. Gating sub/dub via marcatori di filename SUB_ITA/ITA sulla qualityLabel (mai sostituzioni di lingua). Tutti gli episodi sono server-rendered sulla pagina titolo (anche serie da 1000+ episodi).
